iqbalshaid/BusinessAnalyzer_Backend: AI Research Copilot — a FastAPI backend running a LangGraph pipeline that researches companies and generates structured briefing reports, with live progress streaming (SSE) and persisted session state. Containerized with Docker Compose for local/dev/prod, shipped through GitHub Actions CI/CD to GHCR and AWS EC2, with a React + TypeScript + Vite frontend served behind Nginx.
iqbalshaid/Shadow-AI-Discovery: Tool to discover and track unsanctioned AI usage (Shadow AI) across an organization.
botivate-os/frontend_botivate_os: Botivate OS is a modular business-operations ERP. On the Next.js + React + Redux + Tailwind frontend I build the Order-to-Dispatch, Production Planning and Lead-to-Order (enquiries, quotations, call tracking) modules, along with Inventory, SCOT reporting, Checklist & Delegation workflows, and role-based settings and designations.
botivate-os/backend_botivate_os: REST API behind Botivate OS, built with Node.js, Express, Prisma and PostgreSQL. I work on the order-to-dispatch and production-planning services (job cards, material returns, TAT tracking), lead-to-order sync, role-based permissions, inventory reorder alerts and WhatsApp campaign triggers.
iqbalshaid/Blinkit-clone: Full-stack Blinkit-style quick-commerce clone with product catalog, categories and admin panel.
